purpose: Provide an executable validator for Hermitian metric compatibility of finite-mesh rho_E transition data on the candidate Iwasawa finite-element cell.

supported_format_v1.mesh_N: positive integer subdivision parameter for the closed cell {0,...,N}^6
supported_format_v1.generator_data: same constant or table-valued g1..g6 format accepted by the mesh rho_E validator
supported_format_v1.metric_data: Hermitian metric matrix H(z), supplied as a constant matrix or a values table keyed by x1,x2,y1,y2,t1,t2
supported_format_v1.complex_entry: matrix entries are either real numbers or [real, imag]

script_exit_codes.0: complete finite-mesh rho_E plus metric candidate passes implemented checks
script_exit_codes.1: complete candidate fails an implemented algebraic or metric check
script_exit_codes.2: candidate is incomplete/open, such as null generators, missing mesh_N, or missing metric_data

verdict.next_step: Fill a selected rho_E plus Hermitian metric candidate, run cocycle and metric validators, then validate sector projection maps before assembling D_E, Gram, and stiffness matrices.
